_comment: B09 last item: can super jump co-exist with a launch plant? Lane readings from the operator's B08_SuperJump_EOL movie. Regenerate: tools/phase4_b09_seed_lane_probe.py
row_item: super-jump's interaction with plants/dandelion/cannon (registry: unstarted, unscoped)

lane_model.packing: high nibble = selected output, low nibble = highest available

stage: LEVEL01/LEVEL1.DAT (bird level) -- one of only 3 stage files with 4 blue tokens
finding: Brown stays 1/1 for the entire level while blue climbs 0->4. Brown tier 1 is MUSHROOM, so dandelion (3) and cannon (4) are UNAVAILABLE in the bird level. Super jump + dandelion/cannon is impossible there. Super jump + mushroom IS possible, so the item is narrower than 'launch plants' in general.
not_shown: Campaign-wide impossibility. Canon records the token-upgrade write as n*17 -- a token SETS the tier rather than incrementing it -- and the bird level has ZERO orange tokens, which is why brown sits at baseline 1. LEVEL05/LEVEL.DAT and LEVEL09/LEVEL.DAT (the other stages with blue>=4) have ONE orange token each; the tier those author is unmeasured.

seed_token_kinds_resolved.note: The E08 census left 0x2C/0x2D as bare codes, which I wrongly described as 'unnamed seed kinds'. They are purple and yellow, bound via the lane addresses 0x800A659B/9C that FUNC_80054554 already records as their counters.

next_experiment: Read the orange-token payload tier in LEVEL05/LEVEL.DAT and LEVEL09/LEVEL.DAT (static, type-0x3f records). If both author brown <= 2, super jump + dandelion/cannon is impossible campaign-wide and this item closes as a reviewed negative. If either authors >= 3, that stage is the recording target.
